{{Quote|Not only were the shipyards that encircled the planet destroyed, but we are told that the Sith invaders slaughtered everyone who did not immediately swear allegiance to the apparent leader of the Sith, an unnamed Emperor of whom absolutely nothing is known.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
Shortly after the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] return to known space in [[3681 BBY]], [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] '''launched an attack''' on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] holdings at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in one of the earliest battles of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The attack was part of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] strategy to secure [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] early in his war against the Republic. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Armada]] led the assault, which was focused primarily on the [[Sluis Van Shipyards|Republic shipyards]] in the sector. [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Imperial starfighters]] engaged the shipyard's defenses and ultimately destroyed the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] station with little resistance from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], as the galactic government had been caught off-guard by the swiftness of the Sith's incursion upon the galaxy. With the world under their command, the Sith slaughtered any Republic defenders and Sluis Van civilians who refused to swear allegiance to their [[Tenebrae|Emperor]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Horrifying reports from the Outer Rim seemed to portend the utter destruction of the Republic. The rapid onset of galaxy-wide terror and panic was part of the Sith Emperor's meticulous calculations. His plan was flawless.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:Aparo_assault.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The capture of the Tingel Arm was the first of the Empire's Outer Rim operations.]]
In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline6date" /> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] returned to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] and initiated a conflict of unrivaled proportions against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Timeline 6" /> In this [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] first priority was to secure the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] before making plans regarding a push toward the Republic's heart in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Timeline 5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> Striking from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the Sith achieved several decisive victories in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] while the Republic struggled to organize an appropriate response. The [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was eventually able to mount an [[Tingel Arm campaign|operation]] to retake the Tingel Arm, but was defeated and driven out of the region.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|We have only just learned of another terrible military defeat. The strategically vital world of Sluis Van has fallen.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
While the Republic was thrown into disarray following the loss of the Tingel Arm, the Empire moved forward with its assault. The Sith launched an offensive in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], specifically targeting the Republic's [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-[[Shipyard/Legends|manufacturing facilities]]. The Empire's attack on the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was headed by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial naval forces]], which focused on the [[Sluis Van Shipyards|shipyards]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] in a ring formation and were entirely undefended by Republic naval forces. Imperial [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] attacked the shipyards, which were protected by only on-station [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacements. The starfighters eventually broke through the defenses and were able to fracture and destroy the ring that made up the space station.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> Much as they had on many other conquered worlds, the Sith they went about executing any civilian or government worker who refused to swear allegiance to the Sith Emperor after their seizure of Sluis Van. [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] personnel were not given the option of surrender, and were hunted down and killed.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Republic leaders and members of the Jedi Council arranged an emergency meeting in the Senate to prioritize the galaxy's defense, but the session quickly became mired in politics.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:Jedi_Council_Great_Galactic_War.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi Council and members of the Senate discuss the Sith advance.]]
In conjunction with the successful attack on Sluis sector, the Empire staged a [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and an [[Minos Cluster Campaign|incursion]] into the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. These events, in addition to the loss of the Tingel Arm and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Korriban|defeat]] at [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], led the leaders of the Republic to organize an [[Senate emergency defense session|emergency session]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in order to organize the defense of the galaxy. The session quickly took a negative turn, with [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] refusing to participate if their worlds were not given priority defense.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

Meanwhile, the Sith continued to sweep the Outer Rim, securing a sturdy power base before beginning their push into the galactic core.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The Empire was entirely successful in those aims until the Republic's first [[First Battle of Bothawui|major]] [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|victories]] at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> During this period, the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]] kept a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] in which he documented the early conflicts of the war—including the battle of Sluis Van.<ref name="JoMGD" /> As a [[Jedi historian]] in the years following the Sith Empire's victory in the war in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Gnost-Dural made a [[Holodocumentary|holorecord]] that also detailed the Empire's early operations against the Republic, including the attack in the Sluis sector.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

By the onset of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Sluis sector was once again renowned throughout the galaxy for its shipyards.<ref name="HoloNet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_4.html|Sluis Sector Secedes; Seswenna Restates Loyalty}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict in the Sluis sector was first mentioned in the [http://swtor.com/info/holonet/allegiances/sith-empire Sith Empire's] page on [[The Holonet]], an online feature available on [http://swtor.com ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''{{'s}} official site] which provides background information on the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The battle was later pictured and given context in the sixth entry of the [[Galactic Timeline]]. The timeline details the history of the galaxy prior to the events of ''The Old Republic'' and is narrated by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Gnost-Dural, vocally performed by [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="T6 news">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100122_001|text=Onslaught of the Sith Empire|nolive=1}}</ref>

The image of the battle provided in ''Onslaught of the Sith Empire'' depicts the Sluis planet and its [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the exact way the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] was depicted in the [[2006]] LucasArts game, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' and its expansion, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''. In fact, the single image of the battle, as seen at the top of this article, appears to be identical to a screen shot of Kuat from ''Forces of Corruption'', as seen [[:File:Eaw Kuat.jpg|here]].
